title: Bounded runtime cache cleanup
objective: Extend lease-safe bounded automatic cache retention from compiled modules to dynamic eval/exec artifacts, with unified dry-run reporting and deterministic temporary-root tests

oracles: deterministic temporary cache roots; no test inspects or mutates the real user cache

handoff.summary: The ordinary imported-module cache already had bounded automatic cleanup, but the compiler-versioned dynamic eval/exec cache had grown independently without leases or maintenance. Both standard cache families now share exact-root validation, current/newest/pinned/leased retention, age and size pressure, bounded detached cleanup, and dry-run-first CLI reporting. Dynamic compilation acquires one de-duplicated generation lease per process before reading or writing its standard cache; explicit SAGEJS_DYNAMIC_CACHE_DIR locations remain outside automatic maintenance. Focused temporary-root tests cover dynamic policy, family mismatch refusal, CLI selection, standard-root-only scheduling, and the existing crash/contention matrix.
risks: The 2 GiB target is per cache family and remains best effort: current, newest, pinned, and leased generations are hard protections and may keep either family over target.

Automatic policy environment variables retain their historical SAGEJS_MODULE_CACHE names even though the same retention settings now govern the standard dynamic cache; renaming them would add configuration churn without changing behavior.

pnpm test:changed compares this integration branch with the old public main and expands to 648 files; it was stopped after its rebuild invalidated dist/module-cache-build, then a clean uninterrupted build and the focused suite passed.

The branch remains active rather than review because its older base cannot produce clean lane-wide receipts: compiler fixtures miss the lazy random and exact_vector_public modules fixed by the module-isolation lane, while integration has unrelated native-profile/performance failures. These failures are recorded; the cache-focused, build, architecture, and strict gates pass.

The exact source tip 7405391 has a clean merge-tree against integration base 051d72e. Commit d81023c is under independent review; the follow-up 7405391 only strengthens the dynamic lease lifecycle regression and should be included in exact-tip review.
